That line is moved up 0.6 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 24 Nov: 36.9 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 36.8 °C. 25 Nov: 36.9 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 36.7 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-21, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER measured for the grid cell around Manaus on these days, once each measurement has settled (14 days): correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not. It is not checked against reported disasters.

outlooks.title: Unusually heavy rain forecast for Manaus, 28 Nov to 29 Nov
outlooks.issuedAtBasis: Timestamp of the numerical weather prediction model run, issued before the target window.
outlooks.confidence: This forecast covers days 7 to 8 ahead. The method was tested only on forecasts made 3 and 5 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul 2026 to 17 Oct 2026: at 5 days ahead, 23% of the days it flagged crossed the line (2% of days did anyway) and it flagged 18% of the days that crossed. Days beyond 5 ahead were not tested. Those are day-by-day rates; this forecast is graded on its whole window.
